timing: after HOLDOUT v1 launch and before any HOLDOUT v1 output/result inspection

issue.problem: The v1 runner passed the complete full_behavior feature vector to participant_state_permutation, so generic baseline price/size/activity controls were shuffled together with participant-added behaviour state.
issue.consequence: The placebo was not nuisance-preserving and could be artificially weak, biasing the falsification in favor of participant behaviour.

correction.rule: Keep all frozen BASELINE columns fixed and permute only participant-added full_behavior features within the same preregistered market/time or frequency-matched strata.

invalidated_attempt.instruction: Do not inspect or use v1 output. The first valid HOLDOUT exposure is corrected kernel v2.
